profile.headline: Software Engineer I at USAA
profile.summary:
I love to solve puzzles and I’m always striving to learn more about crafting quality software and thinking about how things can be improved. Some of my passions include discussing agile practices, writing code, learning new things, experimenting with technology, and collaborating with other people to solve challenging problems. 

I have experience practicing extreme programming as a full stack developer and also doing research in computational life sciences in the higher education industry. If you have similar interests or just want to chat about technology, please feel free to connect with me!

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Working as a Research Assistant in the Center for Computational Epidemiology and Response Analysis (CeCERA). 

Duties: 
-Coordinating the development and maintenance of the application RE-PLAN, an evidence-based response planning tool. 
-Researching the properties of contact networks in the context of computational epidemiology.

Automata Theory (Fall 2016 and 2017)

positions.title: National Security Internship Program (NSIP) Intern
positions.description:
Participated in a bio-surveillance web application competition for the national security internship program at PNNL. Our team won first place with our web application, SensAlert. 

Our app leverages wearable devices data to provide real-time analysis and alerts to analysts tracking groups of people in high-risk situations and/or strenuous environments. The motivation behind the design and development of the app is to counter heat-related illnesses by utilizing physiological and environmental data from wearable devices to quantify stressors. The app provides both aggregated information on the group’s performance as a whole as well as individual details on each person’s sensor data. 

Personal Responsibilities: 
-Developed back-end functionality of the app using a Flask server and MongoDB database 
-Created miniature data pipeline to mimic real-time data streaming 
-Created Python script which continuously gets data from csv files and posts to a server 
-Implemented real-time analysis of stressors by calculating the Physiological Strain Index to evaluate an individual’s response to heat strain
-Developed front-end visualizations with a React web framework

projects.title: Quantifying Traversability of Roads Using Digital Elevation Models
projects.description:
This project aims to estimate road elevation in order to determine its walkability. Walkability of roads can have a large impact on the environment, public health, and urban planning. Currently, two methods have been implemented performing nonlinear interpolation of the elevation across the road. 

Data was used from Open Street Map and Digital Elevation Models were taken from the United States Geological Survey (USGS). 

Tools used include PostGIS, a spatial database extension for PostgreSQL.

projects.title: Spatial Partitioning of Alcohol Related Crime in Denton
projects.description:
Used crime data to perform a spatial partitioning of the city of Denton to determine the best locations to place police officers in order to manage and address alcohol related crime. 
Used tools such as ArcMap to correlate different sets of the the population to alcohol related crime.
